patch_foraging_assay.note: Deposit Data_F6.BEF = paper Fig. 7B, 7E and 7-figure supplement 1C: fraction of time roaming on sparse food, one value per animal (NaN entries dropped).

uniform_food_density.note: Deposit Data_F6.G = paper Fig. 7F: wild type at two uniform food densities. The 200 fraction values per condition are tightly clustered and are read as resamples; their mean is reported. The durations' unit is not stated in the legend; use them only as ratios between conditions.
